messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 38(4)

Article 38 Operational obligations of notified bodies. 4. Where, in the course of the monitoring of conformity, following the adoption of an approval decision, in accordance with Annex IX, a notified body finds that machinery or a related product no longer complies, it shall require the manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions and shall suspend or withdraw the approval decision, if necessary. Where corrective actions are not taken or do not have the required effect, the notified body shall restrict, suspend or withdraw any approval decisions, as appropriate.

response.text:
notified body | shall require | manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions | machinery or a related product is found to no longer comply during monitoring after an approval decision | "it shall require the manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions"
notified body | shall suspend or withdraw | approval decision | if necessary | "shall suspend or withdraw the approval decision, if necessary"
notified body | shall restrict, suspend or withdraw | any approval decisions | corrective actions are not taken or do not have the required effect | "the notified body shall restrict, suspend or withdraw any approval decisions, as appropriate"
notified body | monitors conformity | machinery after adoption of an approval decision | conducted in accordance with Annex IX | "in the course of the monitoring of conformity, following the adoption of an approval decision, in accordance with Annex IX"
